notes.title: Special Announcement: Featured on Games in Sweden event!
notes.content:
[b]Special Announcement from Fae & Fauna team: Featured on Games in Sweden event! 
[/b]
Hello wonderful Fae & Fauna Community!

🎮We're overjoyed to share some incredible news with you, as we’ve been selected to be a part of the Games in Sweden event! 🎮
It's so exciting to be a part of this event celebrating games made in Sweden. The Swedish game dev community has welcomed us with open arms we're proud to finally be a part of it. Through the Sweden game incubator, we’ve received so much support and help on the journey to make this studio a reality. 

🏡🫎We want to give an extra shout-out to our fellow neighbor indie studios (whom we have breakfast with every Tuesday) that we hold closer to our hearts and we’d love if you’d check them out as well! 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2154240/Odinfall/]Odinfall[/url][/b] is a cool Rough-lite viking inspired twin-stick shooter, made by some extremely passionate and nice people at [b]Ember Paw Games.[/b] Their game gets your heart pumping and your palms sweaty (in a good way), and a game you should definitely keep on your radar (and your wishlist)

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2057760/Esoteric_Ebb/]Esoteric Ebb[/url][/b] is a Disco-like RPG, that mixes hilarious witty writing with political conspiracies, which shouldn’t work, but with [b]Christoffer Bodegård at Sudden Snail[/b] expertise narrative design and built in charm, makes it a blast. The demo is out now, and you don’t want to miss it! 

Thank you for being a vital part of our journey, and supporting your local and non-local game devs. Every nice comment, fanart and suggestion really warms our frosty, desolate and scandinavian hearts. 

Best,
🐾The Fae & Fauna Dev Team 🐾🎮

notes.title: Community Update: A New Year!
notes.content:
[b]🎮 Community Update: A new year! 🌟[/b]

Lovely Fae & Fauna community,

As we kick off 2024, we're thrilled to share some highlights and insights into what's been brewing behind the scenes:

[b]🎬Looking back at 2023[/b]
2023 was the year our studio was born, and we grew from tiny seedlings to bigger, more experienced plants. Through the support of our community, our incubator and fellow game devs, this journey has been a blast. We forged friendships, made important insight and got to discuss our ideas over pizza and a hefty amount of cake. 

[b]🛠️ What Are the Devs Doing?[/b]
Our small team of devs have been hard at work, refining our pipeline and deciding on some big changes for us as a studio and for the project. Therefore we’re happy to say…

[b]🌟 We’ve made the switch to Unreal 5![/b]
Yes, you heard it right! We're making the leap to Unreal Engine 5. This move allows us to take advantage of the tech and more possibilities within this engine. We’re ready to take this game to the next level and want to deliver something beautiful and sustainable. In the coming months ahead, we’re thrilled to show our progress and this new version of Fae & Fauna. 

Thank you for being an essential part of the Fae & Fauna community. Your passion fuels our creativity, and we can't wait to share more incredible moments with you in the coming months. Stay tuned for further updates, and let's make 2024 an unforgettable gaming year!

Digital hugs and platonic kisses,
The Fae & Fauna Dev Team 🎮✨

notes.title: Fae & Fauna has come to Discord!
notes.content:
